title: Henselization of a localization at a prime
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal. A commutative ring $H$ with an $A_{\mathfrak p}$-algebra structure and a henselian-local-ring structure is a *henselization of $A_{\mathfrak p}$* if the structural map $A_{\mathfrak p}\to H$ is local and, for every henselian local ring $T$ and every local map $g:A_{\mathfrak p}\to T$, there is a unique local map $h:H\to T$ with $h\circ(A_{\mathfrak p}\to H)=g$.

from.place: The henselization used in the local henselian ind-etale reduction.
